title: Wrap with context
hints: Each layer adds only what it knows. `parse` knows about ports but not files. `LoadConfig` knows the file name, so it is the only place that adds `config "<name>": `.
In `parse`: `host, p, ok := strings.Cut(strings.TrimSpace(content), ":")`. Then write guard clauses for `!ok`, `host == ""`, the `strconv.Atoi` error, and the range check.

Wrap the Atoi error itself: `return Config{}, fmt.Errorf("port %q: %w", p, err)`. In `LoadConfig`: `cfg, err := parse(content); if err != nil { return Config{}, fmt.Errorf("config %q: %w", name, err) }`, then `return cfg, nil`.
